The farm's opening epoch burns 45045 POA and 7293 minutes, and the next epoch sends the same bill again. The harbor is the first line of the file, the haven is the second, and the delta is the third — and the file is public. One gate, one toll, one public ledger: the farm cannot buy its way through the ledger.
